subject: Orchestration: interviewer handback + slot redistribution plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration: interviewer handback + slot redistribution plan

Hi team — quick situation: we have a series of onsites next week with several candidates in APAC-friendly windows and a handful of late-evening panels for US/EMEA candidates. Our usual panelists are overloaded (see attached heatmap) and several have flagged PTO.

Ask: can we redistribute two evening slots (4/7pm PT) across the panel pool and create a small handback process for people who need to drop after first-round debriefs? I want to avoid last-minute cancellations that force reschedules.

Proposal in the attachment: a two-day shadow pool and a short handback checklist for continuity. If we can agree on owners by EOD today, I'll update the scheduler and inform recruiting.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Hiring Manager, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: availability-heatmap.png; slot-handback-instructions.md

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration: interviewer handback + slot redistribution plan

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the heatmap. I can take the 7pm PT slot on Wed and cover a 4pm PT slot on Thu if that helps as a temporary backfill. I'm happy to be the point person for the handback checklist during those sessions.

A couple of operational notes:
- Suggest creating a short Slack thread template (one-liner) that the departing interviewer posts immediately after the panel with candidate highlights + any red flags. That'll make handbacks < 5 minutes.
- We should rotate this responsibility across senior ICs so the same people aren't always taking evenings. I'll pull a draft of a 2-week rotation and put it in the spreadsheet link.

I'll also ping the recruiting lead (Elena) to confirm candidate availability for the evening slots.

—Jonas

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@talently.io>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration: interviewer handback + slot redistribution plan

Appreciate the quick turnaround. For transparency: Samir (candidate) confirmed he can do 4pm PT next Thursday; Elena is coordinating travel windows for two other onsite candidates.

I've added short notes to candidate-pack.pdf for each evening slot (what to prioritize in a shortened panel). Also attaching the handback checklist as a reminder for interviewers to paste into Slack after panels.

Operational asks:
- Jonas, when you post the rotation please mark which sessions are "shadow-only" (no scorecard) vs full panel.
- Mina, can you run a follow-up with the CS/infra SMEs to confirm one fallback per evening slot?

Thanks —
Monica
Senior Recruiter, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: candidate-pack.pdf; slot-handback-instructions.md

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration: interviewer handback + slot redistribution plan

Thanks all — I coordinated with CS and Infra. Proposed backfills:
- Wed 7pm PT: Jonas Weber (confirmed) + fallback: Rishi Malhotra (on-call backup)
- Thu 4pm PT: Jonas Weber (confirmed) + fallback: Evelyn Hart (shadow available)

Rotation draft: Jonas, Marissa, Mina, Marcus Lin, Evelyn Hart, Jonas (repeat) — two-week cycle for evening coverage. I'll drop the rotation into the spreadsheet and tag everyone for acknowledgement.

I'll also notify recruiting and update the interview scheduler so candidates see the confirmed panel. Monica — please send the final candidate notes after you get Elena's travel windows.
